what: Skill says read column 19 of ops_perf_results CSV as DEVICE KERNEL DURATION; on this p150 the column index differed and the duration was ~22.5 s for every run because one core (phys 11,4) had an unsynced profiler timestamp. Had to recompute the span from profile_log_device.csv excluding outlier cores.
suggest: Read by header name not index, and add a sanity check + recipe: if duration is implausible, compute span from profile_log_device.csv *-KERNEL zones, dropping cores whose start is far from the median.

what: sol_ns_blackhole (16,018 ns) and board notes assume a 7-bank p100a, but the run board is a p150 with 8 DRAM banks (SOL ~14,016 ns). Perf gap to SOL is misstated unless the agent notices and recomputes.
suggest: Store SOL per board variant (or bytes + per-bank bandwidth) and tell agents to recompute from device.dram_grid_size().
